name: llm-wiki
description: Agent-native local Markdown wiki tooling with MCP access to context, search, plans, and safe apply.

interface.shortDescription: Expose a local source-backed Markdown wiki to agents.
interface.longDescription: LLM Wiki turns raw sources into a maintained Markdown knowledge graph and exposes context, search, query, maintenance, benchmark, plan, and safe apply tools through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Use LLM Wiki MCP tools to inspect this workspace and answer with source-backed wiki evidence.
Search the maintained wiki for the relevant concepts, then summarize the answer with page paths.
Run llmw_context, llmw_next, and llmw_health_check before proposing maintenance work.
